completion_checks: Requirement conformance and engineering quality are assessed separately.
Actionable findings identify a plausible failure and supporting evidence.
Reviewer identity and any independence claim are grounded in host-supplied facts.
failure_modes: A blocking defect or unresolved required finding remains: failed.
Required source, specification, or evidence is unavailable: blocked.
Evidence is stale or review independence required by policy cannot be established: inconclusive.
